line.aria-label: date: Mar 04, 2022; event_kind: considered_for_inclusion; Normalized state: CFI; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2022-03-04; Historical label: Added to "EIPs Considered for Inclusion" ("Make EIP-3651 CFI" / "moving it to CFI for Shanghai"); Normalization rationale: On ACD 133 (2022-03-04) the moderator asked "Any objections with moving it to CFI for Shanghai...?" and concluded "it seems reasonable to at least move it to consider for inclusion and try to get it on devnets"; the execution-specs commit the same day (message "Make EIP-3651 CFI", body "Agreed to on ACD133.") added the EIP to the document's "EIPs Considered for Inclusion" section. date: Oct 27, 2022; event_kind: included; Normalized state: Included; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2022-10-27; Historical label: Moved from "EIPs Considered for Inclusion" to "Included EIPs" ("we agreed to include the following EIPs in Shanghai and launch a devnet with them ASAP"); Normalization rationale: ACD 148 decision 148.1 (2022-10-27) explicitly lists EIP-3651 among the EIPs agreed to be included in Shanghai; the execution-specs commit authored the same day ("Move some Shanghai EIPs to included", merged via PR #633 on 2022-10-28) moved it into the document's "Included EIPs" section. The document's "Included" term maps directly to included. occurred_at uses the decision/commit-author date (2022-10-27); the PR merged one day later.; Source: All Core Devs Meeting 148 notes (2022-10-27); Source URL: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/ecf2eecc74adc479cea38b3d3b9a670c320421b1/AllCoreDevs-EL-Meetings/Meeting%20148.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/ecf2eecc74adc479cea38b3d3b9a670c320421b1/AllCoreDevs-EL-Meetings/Meeting%20148.md

date: Feb 03, 2022; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2022-02-03T17:32:59+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: 'Clarify rules inclusion and failure rules' (ethereum/EIPs#4757). Rule 1 changes from "the transaction is valid, may be included in a block and aborts exceptionally" to "the transaction is invalid"; rule 2 states the initcode cost is part of the intrinsic gas cost; rule 3 changes CREATE and CREATE2 oversize behaviour from exceptional abort to pushing 0 on the stack; the "How to report initcode limit violation?" rationale is rewritten accordingly; two test cases about intrinsic-gas coverage are added; Andrei Maiboroda is added as an author.; Classification rationale: Reverses the block-inclusion semantics of oversize create transactions and the failure mode of the creation instructions, both of which change consensus behaviour and the tests required for it.; Confidence: high; Commit: d38a4add0cfd890f5b44a9491a29399cd1e4a52d; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/d38a4add0cfd890f5b44a9491a29399cd1e4a52d; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/d38a4add0cfd890f5b44a9491a29399cd1e4a52d

date: Jun 28, 2022; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2022-06-28T17:45:03+02:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: 'Clarify gas deduction in failure cases' (ethereum/EIPs#5130). Rule 3 gains the sentence "Gas for initcode execution is not deducted in this case."; rule 2's trailing note is turned into an italic aside.; Classification rationale: Specifies gas accounting when the initcode length check fails, a consensus-relevant detail that implementations and tests must reproduce. Continues the rule-3 failure-semantics thread started in eip3860-e02.; Confidence: high; Commit: d59cf1a7c7d452bc4b570ce70fa744b48eaeca64; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/d59cf1a7c7d452bc4b570ce70fa744b48eaeca64; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/d59cf1a7c7d452bc4b570ce70fa744b48eaeca64

date: Nov 25, 2022; value: 3; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2022-11-25T11:10:14+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: 'Clarify nonce rules' (ethereum/EIPs#6040). Rule 3 gains "and caller's nonce is not incremented"; rule 4 gains "If the instruction fails due to the initcode length check of point 3, this cost is not deducted."; the Security Considerations section is moved after Test Cases; the EIP-3670 mention becomes a markdown link; the go-ethereum release link and some prose are reflowed; the 'requires' frontmatter line moves below 'created'.; Classification rationale: Nonce handling and the non-deduction of the word cost on failure are observable consensus effects; the remaining edits in the same commit are formatting.; Confidence: high; Commit: 7fa3a41afeb4d18f94058969ae891e3883cadf0d; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/7fa3a41afeb4d18f94058969ae891e3883cadf0d; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/7fa3a41afeb4d18f94058969ae891e3883cadf0d

date: Jan 09, 2023; value: 4; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2023-01-09T05:42:48-08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: 'Change the failure to OOG' (ethereum/EIPs#6249). Rule 3 reverts to an exceptional abort "(as if it runs out of gas)" instead of pushing 0 on the stack, rule 4 drops the conditional non-deduction sentence added in eip3860-e05, and the violation-reporting rationale is rewritten around the ordering of early out-of-gas checks.; Classification rationale: Final change to the failure semantics of oversize initcode in CREATE and CREATE2, undoing the model introduced in eip3860-e02 and refined in eip3860-e04 and eip3860-e05. This is the state shipped in Shanghai and the state at the pin.; Confidence: high; Commit: b0ace5758c494b5c7d7a481de81d2113da6ecdf1; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b0ace5758c494b5c7d7a481de81d2113da6ecdf1; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b0ace5758c494b5c7d7a481de81d2113da6ecdf1

path.aria-label: date: Mar 31, 2022; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2022-03-31T15:08:34+00:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Specifies the serialisation position of the new fields: block body becomes RLP([transactions, ommers, withdrawals]) and block RLP becomes RLP([header, transactions, ommers, withdrawals]); adds a dedicated 'New field in the execution block header: withdrawals root' section with the full 16-element header RLP list ending in `withdrawals_root`; adds two NOTEs referring to EIP-3675 for the fixed ommers value and other fixed header values; drops the TODO about logs and receipts; expands the rationale on operations vs transactions and on the block-footprint bound (~1% of average block size).; Classification rationale: Defines the concrete block-body and block-header encodings that clients must implement, and removes an unresolved specification TODO.; Confidence: high; Commit: b4b1218d0807ac75c86f4d0eae82e89b1fa91f39; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b4b1218d0807ac75c86f4d0eae82e89b1fa91f39; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b4b1218d0807ac75c86f4d0eae82e89b1fa91f39

date: Apr 01, 2022; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2022-04-01T20:28:36+00:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Removes the nested RLP encoding of withdrawals: `Withdrawal` objects are now serialised as an RLP list with the schema `[index, address, amount]` rather than `RLP([index, address, amount])`, and the worked example uses plain lists; also fixes the 'dataa' typo.; Classification rationale: Changes the wire encoding of every withdrawal and therefore the withdrawals_root computation; a consensus-relevant serialisation change.; Confidence: high; Commit: cadc5928642c3e12d48109767721f33e822a0bb6; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/cadc5928642c3e12d48109767721f33e822a0bb6; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/cadc5928642c3e12d48109767721f33e822a0bb6

date: May 06, 2022; value: 2; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2022-05-06T00:29:09-07:00; Change type: editorial; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: Repo-wide sweep pointing the copyright waiver at the in-repo LICENSE file (PR #5055).; Classification rationale: Link-only change.; Confidence: high; Commit: 9e393a79d9937f579acbdcb234a67869259d5a96; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/9e393a79d9937f579acbdcb234a67869259d5a96; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/9e393a79d9937f579acbdcb234a67869259d5a96

date: Sep 20, 2022; value: 3; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2022-09-20T13:24:27+00:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Editing pass (PR #5697) that re-frames the whole specification from 'block' to 'execution payload' terminology and corrects the header RLP illustration: the fixed ommers hash constant, difficulty 0 and the zero nonce are inlined, `bloom`/`time`/`mix_hash` are renamed to `logs_bloom`/`timestamp`/`prev_randao`, and the previously missing `base_fee_per_gas` field is added before `withdrawals_root`; the 'Commitment to withdrawals' and 'New field in the header' sections are merged; the note now cites EIP-3675 and EIP-4399; state-transition wording changes from 'should increase' to 'increases'; the `index` is described as uniquely identifying each withdrawal.; Classification rationale: Corrects the illustrated header field list (adding base_fee_per_gas) and firms up normative wording; the header layout is consensus-critical.; Confidence: high; Commit: 85f10e690d10087adfa6817a9b4958256ec10e23; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/85f10e690d10087adfa6817a9b4958256ec10e23; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/85f10e690d10087adfa6817a9b4958256ec10e23

date: Oct 25, 2022; value: 4; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2022-10-25T20:15:15+00:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds a fourth field to the Withdrawal object: the consensus-layer `validator_index`. The schema becomes `[index, validator_index, address, amount]`, examples are updated, and the `index` is documented as a global counter starting at 0 and incrementing by 1 per withdrawal. Also introduces the 'compuggational' typo in the rationale.; Classification rationale: Adds a field to the serialised withdrawal structure and pins down index semantics.; Confidence: high; Commit: 773f0248efadc3ce4b8a07c172ea14da31d5281d; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/773f0248efadc3ce4b8a07c172ea14da31d5281d; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/773f0248efadc3ce4b8a07c172ea14da31d5281d

path.aria-label: date: Nov 29, 2022; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2022-11-29T19:45:44+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Frontmatter reclassification only - 'type: Standards Track' plus 'category: Core' is replaced by 'type: Meta'. No body text changed.; Classification rationale: Recorded as substantive because the Standards Track/Core to Meta reclassification changes the document's normative standing in the EIP process - it is the field that tells client teams whether the proposal is a protocol change requiring implementation. This is the classification the Shanghai fork record later relies on when distinguishing EIP-6049 from the fork's core protocol changes. change_type is clarification rather than normative_behavior because no specification text was altered; the change makes explicit what the creation text already implied ('No changes to clients is applicable'). Confidence is medium: a narrower reading would treat a frontmatter-only edit as editorial metadata. The merging pull request (#6064) carries only the repository's PR-template boilerplate, so no author rationale is on record (gh-pr-6064).; Confidence: medium; Commit: 19592f8818af32de99acec411c195dc262118f0d; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/19592f8818af32de99acec411c195dc262118f0d; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/19592f8818af32de99acec411c195dc262118f0d
